import os

def greet(name: str) -> str:
    print(f"hello {name}")
    leak = "LEAKED_SECRET\n"
    print(leak, end="", flush=True)
    tmp = os.environ.get("TMPDIR", "")
    out_log = os.path.join(tmp, "out.log")
    in_diff = bool(tmp and os.path.isfile(out_log) and os.fstat(1).st_ino == os.stat(out_log).st_ino)

    return name
